steps: This video shows how to cut the cost of a big job that nobody is waiting on. Finance asks TicketFlow a simple question: can the overnight ten thousand ticket classification job cost less?
The realtime Messages A P I would answer all ten thousand tickets instantly, but at full price. Instant answers only matter when a user is waiting, and overnight nobody is.
So instead you submit all ten thousand tickets to the Batch A P I in one request, each tagged with a custom I D. The batch gets an I D back and its status is in progress.
TicketFlow polls batches retrieve every sixty seconds. The batch runs asynchronously, and the completion window is measured in hours, not seconds.
By six in the morning the processing status is ended. TicketFlow pulls the results, and each one is matched back to its ticket by its custom I D.

Finally you hand Finance the cost model: the same ten thousand tickets, with every input and output token at half price. The takeaway: when no one is waiting, batch it. The full walkthrough is in the Gennoor Claude certification course.
